###  🔎 Trends & news

* **[Sam Altman himself leaked OpenAI’s roadmap](https://x.com/sama/status/1889755723078443244)** on Twitter yesterday. GPT-4.5 (internally called Orion) is the last non-reasoning model from OpenAI. GPT-5 will be a system with levels of intelligence based on pricing tiers. It’ll be a unified model with access to all tools like Search, Canvas, Thinking, Deep Research etc. Users will not have to pick from half a dozen different options—it’ll just work. 

  * The tentative **timeline for GPT-4.5/GPT-5 is weeks/months** as per Sam. I assume that means March end/mid-May.

* [Working in that direction](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/1889822643676913977): o3-mini can now see images in ChatGPT and the **limit for o3-mini-high is now 50 messages/day **(up from 50/week). OpenAI’s o3 also got a [gold medal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06807) at the International Olympiad in Informatics.

* [OpenAI also updated its Model Spec](https://x.com/openai/status/1889781541259321466?s=12) - A guide that tells its models how to behave. This document is also open for anyone to read and use.

* Soon [Deep Research](https://x.com/sama/status/1889679679696806103) will be available to Plus (10 queries/mo) and free ChatGPT users (2 queries/mo).

* **Bolt** can now create [mobile apps](https://x.com/boltdotnew/status/1889706307613073508) too, and **Create** offers a [built-in database](https://x.com/create_xyz/status/1889479526499098830) for apps built on it.

* **Adobe** has finally launched its [Firefly video generation](https://blog.adobe.com/en/publish/2025/02/12/meet-firefly-video-model-ai-powered-creation-with-unparalleled-creative-control) feature to users along with a new Firefly app and standalone [pricing plans](https://adobe.com/products/firefly/plans.html) for it. **Generate Video** is now in public beta, allowing anyone to generate five-second video clips at 1080p. The new Firefly app also allows you to create multimodal workflows with images, videos and audio.

* **Want to build better AI agents?** Galileo just published a [massive (100-page!) guide all about agents.](https://www.galileo.ai/ebook-mastering-agents?utm_medium=paid&utm_source=bens_bites&utm_campaign=sponsorship) Whether you're just starting out or already deep in agent architecture, this guide will help you build more reliable agents that actually do what they're supposed to. [Get your copy of Mastering Agents!](https://www.galileo.ai/ebook-mastering-agents?utm_medium=paid&utm_source=bens_bites&utm_campaign=sponsorship)*

### 👀 ICYMI: New stuff we’ve launched

Microsoft published a new study assessing AI’s effect on our critical thinking. The big question is: [Does AI make us lazy thinkers?](https://bensbites.com/blog/is-ai-making-us-lazy-thinkers?utm_content=new-stuff-launched) Sadly, the quick answer is yes, but our post gets into the nuance behind this discussion.

We've noticed some confusion in the community about the [differences between ChatGPT and the OpenAI API](https://bensbites.com/blog/chatgpt-vs-openai-api-differences-explained?utm_content=new-stuff-launched). We broke down the key distinctions, use cases, and cost implications to help you choose the right option for your projects.

If you know a teacher, you know their hands are full all the time. We’re glad AI’s here to help, so they can focus on teaching. We compiled a list of the [best free AI tools that teachers can use in 2025](https://bensbites.com/blog/top-free-ai-tools-for-teachers-in-2024?utm_content=new-stuff-launched) (including tools for drawing and images)

###  ⚙️ Top new tools

* [Memex](https://memex.tech/?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=bb&utm_campaign=bb_campaign1&utm_content=tp1) - **Chat to build **without writing code. Any tech stack. On your desktop. For extra free credits use code ‘BB’ = Build Boldly.*

* [RabbitHole](https://www.rabbithole.chat/) - **Learn about anything** with branched topics and follow-up Qs. (I really liked the UI)

* [Create apps](https://x.com/create_xyz/status/1889479526499098830) - now ship with a **built-in Postgres database**, powered by Neon

* [Lovabale Launched](https://launched.lovable.app/) - A collection of **apps created with Lovabale**.

* [New Email](https://x.com/zenorocha/status/1889329845613519270) - Build beautiful, responsive, and cross-platform **HTML emails** using natural language.

* [Icons8 illustration generator](https://icons8.com/illustration-generator/) - Generate **usable illustrations** with a tool trained on Icons8’s own library.

* [Learn Copywriting](https://learncopywriting.com/) - Get your **copywork** scored by an LLM.

* [Exa Answer](https://x.com/ExaAILabs/status/1889759186927624422) - Get an LLM **answer to a question** informed by Exa search results.

* This demo of [Alexis](https://x.com/louisjoejordan/status/1889094571264516142), a conversation agent by ElevenLabs is insane 🤯.
